<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Crystal Strider](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2625)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Each long, thin leg of a crystal strider is a single enormous crystal, typically quartz or selenite. The strider uses this panoply of legs and a fluctuating physical structure to rapidly move about crystalline caverns, unimpeded by terrain.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 27

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 25

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 22
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/ElementalEarth_CrystalStrider.png" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 10">[Crystal Strider](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2625)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=57" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 104

**Perception** +20; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 60 feet

**Languages**
[Petran](/Languages.aspx?ID=109)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +19, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +23, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +20

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +3

**Con** +5

**Int** +0

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +1
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 29 

**Fort** +21 

**Ref** +19 

**Will** +20 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 230

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=145)

**Weaknesses**
[sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147) 10

**Crystal Refraction** <actions string="Free Action" /> **Trigger** The crystal strider is targeted by a [light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100) effect; **Effect** The strider redirects the triggering effect to a different creature of its choice within 30 feet or absorbs the effect harmlessly, reducing the number of rounds left to recharge Release Light by 1.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 45 feet, climb 45 feet; precise steps

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
leg +23 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 2d10+13 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
crystal dart +21 ([range increment 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)),
**Damage** 2d10+13 piercing

**Precise Steps**   The crystal strider's many narrow legs allow it to ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453).

**Release Light** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15), [Light](/Traits.aspx?ID=100), [Primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134)) The strider emits the light that continually refracts within them to cast [_chromatic ray_](/Spells.aspx?ID=883) as an innate primal spell heightened to 5th rank, with a +21 spell attack roll. The crystal strider can't Release Light again for 1d4 rounds.

**[Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=39)** <actions string="Three Actions" />  Large or smaller, leg, DC 29

</column>

<document level="2" id="creature-family-42" />
name: Crystal Strider
